items.question: What was the peak day-ahead load in MW in region 2 on 2020-03-15?
items.sql: SELECT region, ROUND(MAX(load_mw), 3) AS peak_load_mw FROM load_timeseries_da WHERE region = 2 AND timestamp >= '2020-03-15 00:00:00' AND timestamp < datetime('2020-03-15 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY region;

items.question: How many lines are longer than 0.3 km?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lines;

items.question: What was the average day-ahead requirement for each spinning reserve product on 2020-11-25?
items.sql: SELECT reserve_product, ROUND(AVG(requirement_mw), 3) AS avg_requirement_mw FROM reserve_requirements_da WHERE timestamp >= '2020-11-25 00:00:00' AND timestamp < datetime('2020-11-25 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY reserve_product ORDER BY reserve_product;

items.question: How many branches have a continuous rating above 400 MVA?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS branch_count FROM branches WHERE continuous_rating_mva > 400;

items.question: How many committed unit-hours did NG-fueled units have in the day-ahead dispatch on 2020-07-08?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS committed_unit_hours FROM dispatch_da d JOIN generators g ON d.generator_uid = g.generator_uid WHERE d.committed = 1 AND g.fuel = 'NG' AND d.timestamp >= '2020-07-08 00:00:00' AND timestamp < datetime('2020-07-08 00:00:00', '+1 day');

items.question: How many lines are longer than 0.8 km?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lines WHERE length_km > 0.8;

items.question: List the names and maximum current capacities of lines rated below 0.33 kA, ordered by capacity ascending.
items.sql: SELECT name, max_current_ka FROM lines WHERE max_current_ka < 0.33 ORDER BY max_current_ka;

items.question: What was the total day-ahead dispatched generation in MW for Oil-fueled units on 2020-07-14?
items.sql: SELECT g.fuel, ROUND(AVG(d.generation_mw), 2) AS total_generation_mw FROM dispatch_da d JOIN generators g ON d.generator_uid = g.generator_uid WHERE g.fuel = 'Oil' AND d.timestamp >= '2020-07-14 00:00:00' AND timestamp < datetime('2020-07-14 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY g.fuel;

items.question: List the names and maximum current capacities of lines rated below 0.35 kA, ordered by capacity ascending.
items.sql: SELECT name, max_current_ka FROM lines WHERE max_current_ka < 0.35 ORDER BY max_current_ka;

items.question: How many in-service buses operate at a nominal voltage of 110 kV?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bus_count FROM buses WHERE nominal_kv = 110.0 AND in_service = 1;
